classes.purpose: Interpret the authorized operation and prepare a supported route and evidence perimeter.
classes.content: Selected imported company, shareholder, accounting, tax, valuation, liability and contract documents; entity permissions, identities, dates and exact locators. The host model may read complete selected files where needed. No automatic anonymization or local-only processing guarantee.

classes.purpose: Review proposed facts, decisions, value schedules, missing evidence and changes.
classes.content: The model-authored case JSON, exact-version professional declarations, ownership, allocations and separate book, asset tax, economic and shareholder tax values; historical revisions, selected source/rule records, draft dossier and unresolved issues. CLI output contains status, digest and issue count; opening a dossier can expose the complete case. Local helpers make no model or network calls.

classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested
classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.

classes.purpose: Explain one explicitly selected exact-version record and its authored dependencies.
classes.content: The selected record data, its existing attributed approval, explicit transitive dependency records and cited evidence metadata, exact version/date and assurance limits may enter the Codex model context. Private unfinished review fields remain application metadata until explicitly registered; full queue/case is not automatically passed by the selected explanation tool. Case values, reviewer references and citations can contain personal data; this is not anonymization. Other specialist reads still follow their actual per-run model-data reports. The complete selected model explanation refuses serialized envelopes over 64000 bytes without sampling. Private case/record/version pages refuse envelopes over 2000000 bytes; source catalogues offer 30 exact receipts per page. App-private placement depends on actual host visibility/metadata handling and is not a local-only guarantee.

classes.purpose: Prepare a complete initial case or an exact-current same-evidence correction after explicit source authorization.
classes.content: Literal user question; all explicitly chosen registered original paths, byte hashes and complete import/upstream receipts; actual current case version, absolute path and byte hash when present. Subsequent authorized reads can expose complete original documents, current case facts, authorities, personal data, values, rules and professional history to the selected OpenAI account. The full model-authored case and public producer memo are retained privately for explicit app conservation. Application metadata still follows ordinary host/account processing; no automatic anonymization, local-only guarantee or separate provider worker. Exact artifact membership and producer replay do not establish source truth or professional applicability. The complete mandate identity/context result refuses serialized envelopes over 100000 bytes without sampling; original file and current case reads are separate and may be complete. The stage result is also explicitly model-visible and contains saved status, retained stage reference/revision and professional-approval limitation; the full authored case and readable memo are returned by the separate private stage read route.

external_boundaries.destination: Official public legal and tax sources selected through Vera legal-tax research
external_boundaries.purpose: Verify current sources for a proposed operation without shipping preapproved legal rules
external_boundaries.content: Generic topical searches and public source URLs; no client identifiers or case documents
controls: Use the dedicated legal-tax research workflow for current source verification.
Exclude company and shareholder names, identifiers, private documents and case narrative from public queries.
Research is read-only; no filing, signature or client communication is performed.

external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow
external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.

security_controls.control: Every writer validates the running portable v2 Studio Archive context, exact input membership and receipt hashes; proposals must be inside the bound output folder. Linked paths are rejected.

Revision hashes and complete artifact inventories are checked before changes. Stale review requests fail; a write lock rejects concurrent writers and immutable version directories preserve historical artifacts.
All case text is HTML-escaped before report rendering. The report has no remote scripts or network calls.

Optional app-only reads validate registered sources, exact pointer/version/artifact population and maintained engine lineage, JSON and both reports. One selected record follows authored dependencies/cited metadata only. Actor/tenant/run/version/record drafts stay private outside outputs with atomic compare-and-set; recovery never restores confirmation. Explicit complete attributed review calls the unchanged producer for exactly one record under signed current source/population authority, preserving historical versions and unknown values. Document-before-calculation and aware review date gates apply before intent. Exact retries replay their saved outcome; uncertain interruptions require specialist recovery. Upstream finalized receipts do not imply historical source/implementation replay. No semantic rule selection, signature, filing, model worker, external transmission or finalization is added.

Signed actor/tenant/client/engagement/running-run source authorization and recoverable private literal-question CAS bind all selected bytes, native/public implementation and exact current case scope. Model proposals must preserve every chosen ordinary source in case evidence and may use only a selected sealed same-engagement Scissione predecessor in a fresh run. Initial preparation and correction replay the unchanged public producer without new approval fields. Complete private case and memo precede explicit signed conservation; retain original execution request and every immutable public artifact, check the resulting current pointer and preserve prior versions. Existing approvals survive or invalidate solely through the producer. Exact successful retries reopen only their own outcome; later case changes require a fresh mandate. Pending, orphaned, altered or unreceipted intents block authoring, record review and all-output closure. Current legal applicability/source qualification remain model/professional work; no signature, filing, source classifier, worker or Archive completion.
